title: Microsoft Purview: scan existing SharePoint and OneDrive files for sensitive information (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The roadmap facts, scan controls and billing statements match the sources checked. The briefing clearly separates documented on-demand classification behaviour from the government-cloud release, whose default and cloud-specific licensing remain unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an administrator capability to scan existing SharePoint and OneDrive for Business files at rest for sensitive data.
claims.quote: This new capability will enable admins to scan existing files at rest in SharePoint or OneDrive for business for sensitive data.
